body: House rules from advisor/operator, applies to all agents: work in a fresh git worktree off latest origin/main; read the spec with `aida show <ID>` before implementation; commit with trailing `(SPEC-ID)`; open a PR but do NOT self-merge, advisor reviews keystone work before merge; verify `cargo build -p aida-cli`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy -p aida-cli -- -D clippy::correctness`, and `env -u AIDA_SESSION_ROLE cargo test -p aida-cli`; use plain `// trace:` comments, never `///`; no SPEC-IDs in user-facing output. Several tasks touch `main.rs`; advisor will merge serially and agents should rebase as needed.
